EH section 104 replaces expired Part O with its new institutional grant/service text; old eligibility is not inherited as live law. Do not infer automatic fit/exclusion or universal coverage. The whole EH and own declaration/engrossment/passage witnesses from checkpoint 189 remain; failed roll 150 is not imported. The existing Health core/ref/digests are unchanged. Own passage question precedes voice ayes and Pallone demand/order: 366-57 with 9 Not Voting, Foushee Yea and Massie Nay.
